items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We worked together on a few situations... I played... at this club on the Left Bank that we mentioned with Kenny Clarke in the house band.

ctx.x: And what about Kenny Clarke, as long as we're on this particular group?

I didn’t get to know Kenny very well. I knew him. We worked together on a few situations. The most I got to know Kenny Clarke, as a matter of fact, was on an occasion when I went to Europe to play at a club on the Left Bank called . . .
